title: Separate knowledge-base management API, provider preflight, upload task, and progress boundaries
description: TASK-031 covers KB parser/chunking/retrieval ports and TASK-076 covers ingestion/index jobs. AstrBot's dashboard KB route adds a separate management surface: KB CRUD, embedding/rerank provider preflight, document upload/import/from-URL tasks, upload progress maps, chunk CRUD, stats, and debug retrieval. Rust should define this service boundary before dashboard management routes call KB/provider/storage internals directly.

files.change: Model KB CRUD, document/chunk commands, stats snapshots, and dashboard-facing result DTOs outside HTTP handlers.
Keep provider availability, embedding dimension checks, and rerank smoke tests out of dashboard routes.
Represent background task status, per-file stage progress, success/failure summaries, and retry settings.
Keep HTTP parameter parsing and response mapping thin by delegating to typed KB management services.

criteria: Dashboard KB routes do not directly manage provider preflight or background upload progress maps.
KB retrieval remains separate from KB CRUD/upload management.
Ingestion/indexing jobs from TASK-076 can plug into the management task lifecycle without route-level orchestration.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-kb && cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
